review_scope: Independent raw-JSON/numeric evidence audit only; no arithmetic benchmark or source edits

numeric_policy.integer_parser: Tokenize JSON before JSON.parse; large integer literals remain exact decimal strings. All timestamp/work equations use BigInt.
numeric_policy.wins: Compare exact elapsed_A*operations_B with elapsed_B*operations_A; includes actual jobs,1024steps and differing mode lane counts.
numeric_policy.floating_point: Recompute binary64 elapsed/jobs, elapsed/operations and same-round ratios; tolerance 5e-13*max(1,abs(a),abs(b)) against published values.
numeric_policy.statistics: All eight measured region means retained. Min/median/max/arithmetic mean independently recomputed; weighted pooled elapsed/work labelled separately. Paired median is median of eight same-round ratios, not ratio of medians.

frozen_binding.scope: Current exact source and binary bytes match manager-supplied preperformance freeze. Build-command/library binding is the separate manager manifest.

field_API_comparisons.scope: All field candidate/API pairs; excludes raw-reducer comparison

comba_API_comparisons.scope: General/symmetric Comba versus actual API, both modes; overlaps other totals

row_chain_API_comparisons.scope: Row+serial versus actual API, chain1 only

raw_reducer_comparisons.scope: Serial/precomputed under XOR-fed arbitrary512 recurrence; not field multiply

smoke_identity_only.fields_checked: Corpus descriptor, exact final128-byte outputs/checksums and every cell's trace count/hash/zero/one receipts. No smoke timings read into any P5 numeric comparison.

limitations: Finite canonical multiply/square and XOR-fed arbitrary512 reducer workloads on this frozen one-core GCC profile; no production integration, scalar/upper-layer, novelty, world-record or CT claim.

Every raw reducer step includes forming low=x XOR corpus-low plus reduction. A reducer comparison is not a complete multiply comparison; chain/ILP4 ratios include different whole-job amortization and actual lane counts.

Output canonicality and padding are audited directly from all128byte records. Raw-limb correctness and full each-step trace states are C++ qualification receipts, not regenerated field arithmetic in JavaScript.

The six full trace hashes and no-zero/one counts match across routes, series and the final smoke. Intermediate state bytes and all corpus arrays are not archived in raw JSON, so this audit checks C++ exact-regeneration receipts/hash identities rather than independently rebuilding the field trace/corpus.

Only the last identical job of each timed region is compared after timing; every complete job includes seed reset,1024steps per lane and full128byte serialization/padding. Allocation and corpus generation are excluded.

All calibration shorts and intermediate extension probes are retained. Each later region uses one continuous clock and actual total work. No discarded sample, restarted prefix or selective rerun enters these statistics.
All raw records in these complete runs are verified and every later record reaches200ms; this numeric pass does not rerun synthetic failure-path diagnostics or certify a future failed series.
CPU4, powersave and turbo-enabled endpoints are recorded, not continuous frequency/migration/thermal/SMT/background-activity control.
No P1/P2/P3/P4 or smoke/synthetic timing is pooled. Cross-series combined wins sum independent within-series pairs, while per-series medians remain separate.

Source-visible precomputation or fewer multiplications is not proof of a distinct emitted algorithm or a gain. Small serial/parallel differences require separate codegen interpretation and cannot alone establish an algorithmic speedup.
Timing provides no isolated instruction, spill, cache/bandwidth, port-pressure or critical-path cause. PMU/CT/platform qualifications remain separate.
The current frozen binary hash is verified here; compiler commands, linked-library hashes and emitted-code replay belong to the manager's build/codegen manifest.
